claims.object_text: Transcription-Coupled Non-Homologous End-Joining (TC-NHEJ) to resolve transcription-associated DSBs in brain
claims.quote: HTT joins TC-NHEJ proteins PNKP, Ku70/80, and XRCC4 with chromatin remodeler Brahma-related Gene 1 (BRG1) to resolve transcription-associated DSBs in brain.

claims.object_text: Overexpression restores TC-NHEJ and improves genome integrity, motor defects, and lifespan in a Drosophila HD model
claims.quote: HTT or PNKP overexpression restores TC-NHEJ in a Drosophila HD model dramatically improving genome integrity, motor defects, and lifespan.
